The series follows Neuro Nōgami, a demon who depends on mysteries for sustenance.

Neuro: Supernatural Detective did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Having consumed all the mysteries in the demon world, Neuro travels to the human world in search of more. There, Neuro recruits high school student Yako Katsuragi as a facade for a detective agency.

Because he has eaten every mystery in the demon world, he comes to the human world to feast on the mysteries offered by humans.
